title: AWS re:Invent 2018: Amazon DynamoDB Under the Hood: How We Built a Hyper-Scale Database (DAT321)
summary: An AWS re:Invent 2018 session on how DynamoDB was built as a hyper-scale NoSQL database. It discloses underpinnings of the service and how it is run for over 100,000 customers.
why: HN points to it as an authoritative look at DynamoDB internals and as evidence it is a complex distributed system.

quote.text: here's a talk you might find interesting from one of the folks who built and ran DDB for a long time
